name: high-heel
description: A high-heeled shoe with an open upper and a complete block heel.
useCase: Identify high-heeled shoes in a clothing catalogue.
misuse: Use a visible label when clothing identifies a product, size or dress requirement.

16.reason: The full heel and toe meet the same ground line around the open arch.

24.reason: The larger shoe retains its complete heel and toe on a shared ground line.
